title: Artificially intelligent modeling of macromolecular assemblies.
one_liner_zh: 该综述系统梳理了AI方法（如AlphaFold、RoseTTAFold）与传统粗粒化模拟在蛋白质组装结构建模中的结合策略，虽为综述缺乏新方法，但紧扣蛋白质结构计算问题并具方法整合启发。
abstract: The study of macromolecular assembly formation is one of the most challenging tasks in computational modeling as it requires extensive exploration of conformational and configurational space, especially when driven by conformational transitions or folding instabilities, which are typically associated with high energy barriers. Although this type of study has traditionally been addressed in silico by using techniques that reduce the computational cost of simulations, such as coarse-grained models, artificial intelligence (AI) has recently entered the field at multiple levels, aiding in parameter optimization or trajectory analysis and even replacing potentials or force calculations. Recently developed algorithms such as AlphaFold (AF) and RoseTTAFold enable the direct prediction of final structures with high efficiency and confidence, an achievement that earned them the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. In this study, we review and analyze the different AI-based strategies used to model protein structure and dynamics and simulate macromolecular assemblies, comparing them with traditional methods, to highlight their respective advantages and limitations. By placing these approaches along an ideal continuum in which accuracy increases as interpretability decreases, we show that hybrid solutions and combinations of methods can be devised to maximize their strengths. Finally, we perspectively outline practical strategies for implementing such integrated approaches in a coherent manner, preserving accuracy and feasibility while maintaining insight into aggregation pathways, intermediate structures, and the molecular mechanisms underlying the phenomenon.
abstract_zh: 大分子组装形成的研究是计算建模中最具挑战性的任务之一，因为它需要对构象和构型空间进行广泛探索，尤其是在由构象转变或折叠不稳定性驱动时，这些通常与高能垒相关。尽管这类研究传统上通过使用降低模拟计算成本的技术（如粗粒化模型）在计算机上解决，但人工智能（AI）最近已在多个层面进入该领域，辅助参数优化或轨迹分析，甚至替代势能或力计算。最近开发的算法，如AlphaFold（AF）和RoseTTAFold，能够以高效率和置信度直接预测最终结构，这一成就使它们荣获2024年诺贝尔化学奖。在本研究中，我们回顾并分析了用于建模蛋白质结构和动力学以及模拟大分子组装的不同基于AI的策略，将其与传统方法进行比较，以突出它们各自的优势和局限性。通过将这些方法置于一个理想连续体中，其中准确性随可解释性降低而增加，我们表明可以设计混合解决方案和方法组合，以最大化其优势。最后，我们前瞻性地概述了以连贯方式实施此类集成方法的实用策略，在保持对聚集途径、中间结构及现象背后分子机制洞察的同时，确保准确性和可行性。
